dct_description_sm: Click here for metadata. Quinte Conservation subwatersheds. The geometry of these features were originally derived from the MOE’s Quaternary watershed dataset clipped to QC’s jurisdictional boundary, but underwent subsequent modification by QC staff using ArcHydro in order to accommodate the needs of the Water Resources department. Please be advised that some boundary extents represent political boundaries rather than scientifically proven limits. All studies completed using this data at QC boundary limits should acquire the neighboring CA boundary limit from the appropriate CA.
